title: Locator.X at Jackson Square
summary: A walkable French Quarter campus around Jackson Square and the Mississippi levee: seven-gate underwriting desks, evidence grading, the Academy, market editions and the Louisiana developer desk, all anchored where the Crescent City's emerging market lives.

buildings.name: Cabildo Overview Hall
buildings.use: portfolio summary and cross-market comparison hub

buildings.name: Seven-Gate Underwriting House
buildings.use: parcel mapping and DSCR 1.20 break-even screening

buildings.name: Forecast Turret
buildings.use: predictive model room over ZIP value series

buildings.name: Review Digest Printshop
buildings.use: per-scan digest and 12-month re-underwrite flip scan

buildings.name: Gate Testing Annex
buildings.use: level gates grading capabilities on a real parcel

buildings.name: Bay Premium & NOLA Emerging Pavilions
buildings.use: Bay Area premium and New Orleans emerging-market maps

buildings.name: Parish Records Levee House
buildings.use: parish-by-parish record coverage and data traps briefings

court.name: Court of the Two Gates
court.style: French Quarter courtyard with iron-lace galleries
court.why_here: Sits where the Underwriting Desk's seven gates meet the Evidence Layer; every figure argued here must show coverage before any rate.

quests.title: Run the Seven Gates
steps: Meet Guide at the Overview Hall
Pull a parcel map at the Rosenberg Desk
Pass gates one through seven in order
Hold the break-even line at DSCR 1.20

quests.title: Grade the Number
steps: Carry a forecast to the Grading Annex
Check coverage and the sample floor of five
Log every unknown in the ledger
Collect a review digest

quests.title: Earn the Gate
steps: Enter the Track Atrium and pick a track
Complete lessons in the 92-Lesson Reading Room
Sit the real-parcel exam in the Annex Yard
Count and correct certainty errors

quests.title: Scout the Corridor
steps: Take a feed wire at the French Market Pavilion
Diff new listings at the Diff Board
Score matches on the Corridor Nave map
Report the summary to the Dashboard ticker

quests.title: Brief the Developer
steps: Read the parish record at the Levee House
Flag the named data traps
Zero-weight the cancelled capital vault
Teach the cap-and-support lesson in the Academy
